history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young Asian woman with long, dark, wavy hair and bangs is posed against a collage of vintage posters. She is looking directly at the camera with a playful wink and her right index finger is gently touching her lips. She's wearing a black tank top with "Wong Kar-wai" printed across the chest, beneath which are stills from one of his films, featuring East Asian actors. She has on layered silver necklaces, one with a small pendant, and a silver bracelet on her left wrist, which also features a small butterfly tattoo. The posters in the background are sepia-toned and feature grainy black and white images of men, some smoking, and text in various fonts and languages, reminiscent of old movie posters and concert flyers. The overall lighting is soft and diffused, casting a slight shadow and highlighting her features. The color palette is dominated by muted tones of black, white, sepia, and yellow, creating a retro and slightly moody aesthetic. The mood is cool, confident, and artistic, with a hint of nostalgia.
